verdict.rationale: Stripe documents the whole flow end-to-end. ACS embedded checkout runs the full lifecycle, from cart management through Stripe-created shared payment tokens to completion signalled by the `delegated_checkout.requested_session.completed` webhook. On the seller side, checkout sessions move through incomplete→ready_for_payment→completed and fire `checkout.session.completed`. SPTs carry scoped usage limits and can be revoked, and Link CLI issues one-time-use credentials the agent uses to pay. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent evidence of a completed agent purchase; general availability (ACS is private preview, waitlist/OCA-gated, limited to US/Canada/select EU countries and physical goods).
